headline: Discussed the working draft of procedural rules; final adoption was planned for a later meeting, and no action was taken.
summary: The group discussed and workshopped the working draft of its procedural rules. It planned to adopt a final draft at its next regular monthly meeting. No action was taken, and no members of the public were present.
decisions: No action taken on the motion to adopt the PIC Rules of Procedure after discussion of the working draft.
